description:
Welcome to Evia Pool by The BirthSpace!

 

• About our brand and products:

The BirthSpace creates thoughtfully designed products that honour birth as a powerful, natural experience.

Our Evia Pool is the world’s first fully biodegradable, single-use inflatable birth pool — bringing together comfort, safety, and care for the earth, for both home and professional use.

• What makes us different:

We’re rethinking birth essentials.

Traditional reusable pools require intensive cleaning and chemicals. Standard disposable options create long-term waste.
Evia offers a third way — a calm, supportive water birth experience that is more hygienic, more practical, and designed to biodegrade.

• How affiliates can earn:

Earn 10% commission on every sale through your unique link or code.

With a meaningful, high-value product, authentic sharing tends to convert strongly — especially within pregnancy, birth, and parenting communities.

• How to promote us:

Share from the heart and from your experience.
You might:

  • Talk about water birth and its benefits

  • Share your own or your clients’ experiences

  • Highlight eco-conscious choices in motherhood

  • Show how simple and supportive birth can feel

Instagram, Facebook groups, blogs, and birth networks all work beautifully.

• Other information:

This is more than a product — it’s part of a shift towards more supported, intuitive, and earth-friendly birth.

We’re here to support you, and we’re genuinely grateful to have you as part of this movement 🤍

Thank you for your interest in becoming part of The Birth Space Affiliate Community.


Our affiliate program is designed to support birth workers, educators, content creators and advocates who genuinely believe in improving the birth experience for women and babies.


Commission Structure

Affiliates are placed into one of the following tiers:


Standard Affiliate – 10% commission

Silver Affiliate – 12.5% commission

Gold Affiliate – 15% commission


Tier upgrades are based on a combination of:

- Sales performance

- Consistency

- Community engagement

- Quality of content and representation of the brand

- Professionalism and alignment with The Birth Space values


Tier placements and upgrades are reviewed manually and may change over time.


Affiliate Conduct

Affiliates are expected to:

- Represent The Birth Space honestly and respectfully

- Avoid misleading medical claims

- Use language that is supportive, evidence-aware and woman-centred

- Maintain respectful communication with clients and community members

- Represent the product truthfully and responsibly


We reserve the right to remove affiliates who engage in:

- Spam marketing

- Aggressive sales tactics

- False claims

- Misrepresentation of products

- Harmful, discriminatory or inappropriate behaviour


Discount Codes & Referrals

Affiliate commissions apply only to purchases made through your unique affiliate link or approved discount code.


Self-referrals or misuse of discount codes may result in removal from the program.


Content & Community Participation

We warmly encourage affiliates to:

- Share educational birth content

- Create honest reviews and unboxing videos

- Share birth stories and experiences (with full consent)

- Participate in The Birth Space Village community

- Support and uplift women, families and fellow birth workers


Selected affiliates may also be invited to:

- Become guest educators or presenters

- Participate in special campaigns

- Receive bonus opportunities and collaborations


Payments

Affiliate payouts are issued after the customer order has been completed and the return/refund window has passed.

Payements will be made through paypal every quarter.


Commission rates, payout schedules and affiliate benefits may be updated as the program evolves.


Brand Values

The Birth Space was created to support more instinctive, informed and empowered birth experiences while also helping reduce unnecessary waste within birth environments.


We are looking for affiliates who genuinely resonate with this mission and wish to grow alongside us.


Thank you for being here — we are so happy to have you as part of this journey.


— Delia & The Birth Space
